caption: A logical qubit is encoded, a transversal CNOT acts, fresh ancillas help extract the syndrome, and correction gives the logical output. The ancilla is used only in the syndrome-extraction step: it is coupled to the data qubits there, then measured. It carries no logical information and is never part of the logical output.

spec.title: Fault-tolerant logical gate
spec.aria: Logical qubits are encoded, a transversal gate acts, ancillas help extract the syndrome, and errors are corrected before the logical output.
